**re: Which Ed-Fi properties have no CEDS mapping? Show a few examples and the total count.** Ed-Fi v5.2.0 has **798 properties out of 1,904 total (41.9%) with no CEDS mapping** of any kind (no EXACT, CLOSE, BROAD, or NARROW match to a CEDS HubReference). The other 1,106 properties have at least one CEDS mapping. A few things to keep in mind when reading this: - Per the Ed-Fi card, **mappings live directly on the property nodes** (not on instance nodes like SIF/PESC), and the same property name can appear across multiple Ed-Fi entities — each occurrence has its own mapping judgment. - All mappings are **inferred** (judge: `bridge-jev`), none authored. --- ### Examples of unmapped Ed-Fi properties | Owning Entity | Property | Description | |---|---|---| | `AcademicWeek` | `WeekIdentifier` | The school label for the week | | `AcademicWeek` | `TotalInstructionalDays` | Total instructional days during the academic week | | `AccountabilityRating` | `Rating` | An accountability rating level, designation, or assessment | | `AccountabilityRating` | `RatingProgram` | The program associated with the rating (e.g., NCLB, AEIS) | | `AdditionalImmunization` | `ImmunizationName` | The name of the immunization received | | `Address` | `CongressionalDistrict` | The congressional district in which an address is located | | `AggregatedSurveyQuestionMatrixElementResponse` | `AverageNumericResponse` | The average numeric response for the survey | | `Aid` | `AidConditionDescription` | Condition under which the aid was given | | `ApplicantCharacteristic` | `DesignatedBy` | Person/org/department that designated the characteristic | --- ### Entities with the most unmapped properties
